result.rationale: The controller's update/destroy use EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first with no nil check, and save_host immediately calls host.host = params[...][:host], so a nonexistent id or missing embeddable_host param envelope raises NoMethodError (500). Similarly destroy calls host.destroy on possibly-nil. The model's before_validation calls self.host.sub! which crashes on nil host. All mechanisms are directly visible in the diff.
